name: proton-pass
title: Proton Pass
description: Search and manage your Proton Pass items, generate passwords, and get TOTP codes.
author: izyuumi

commands.name: search-items
commands.title: Browse Items
commands.subtitle: Proton Pass
commands.description: Browse your vaults and search their items

preferences.name: sortBy
preferences.title: Sort items by
preferences.description: Order of the items. ⌘⇧S changes it until the window closes.

preferences.name: sortVaultsBy
preferences.title: Sort vaults by
preferences.description: Order of the vaults. ⌘⇧S changes it until the window closes.

commands.name: list-vaults
commands.title: List Vaults
commands.subtitle: Proton Pass
commands.description: Open Browse Items on your vaults

preferences.name: defaultPasswordType
preferences.title: Password Type
preferences.description: The generator opens with this type.

preferences.name: defaultPasswordLength
preferences.title: Random: Length
preferences.description: Characters in random passwords, from 8 to 128.

preferences.name: includeUppercase
preferences.title: Random: Characters
preferences.label: Uppercase letters
preferences.description: Include uppercase letters in random passwords.

preferences.name: includeSymbols
preferences.label: Symbols
preferences.description: Include symbols in random passwords.

preferences.name: includeNumbers
preferences.label: Numbers
preferences.description: Include numbers in random passwords.

preferences.name: defaultPassphraseWords
preferences.title: Passphrase: Words
preferences.description: Number of words in passphrases.

preferences.name: passphraseSeparator
preferences.title: Passphrase: Separator
preferences.description: Between the words of passphrases.

preferences.name: capitalizeWords
preferences.title: Passphrase: Options
preferences.label: Capitalize words
preferences.description: Start each word of passphrases with a capital letter.

preferences.name: passphraseNumbers
preferences.label: Include numbers
preferences.description: Include numbers in passphrases.

commands.name: get-totp
commands.title: Get TOTP Code
commands.subtitle: Proton Pass
commands.description: Get TOTP codes for your accounts

preferences.name: hideCodes
preferences.title: Codes
preferences.label: Hide codes
preferences.description: Show dots instead of the codes until Show Codes (⌘H). Copying still works.

preferences.name: sortBy
preferences.title: Sort items by
preferences.description: Order of the codes. ⌘⇧S changes it until the window closes.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to pass-cli executable

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: What Enter does on an item.

preferences.name: submitAfterFill
preferences.title: Fill Login
preferences.label: Press Return after the password
preferences.description: Submits the login form.

preferences.name: copyPasswordTransient
preferences.title: Transient Clipboard
preferences.label: Keep copied secrets out of clipboard history
preferences.description: Passwords, TOTP codes, notes and hidden fields.

preferences.name: cacheExpiration
preferences.title: Cache Expiration
preferences.description: How long cached items stay fresh.

preferences.name: enableBackgroundRefresh
preferences.title: Item List
preferences.label: Refresh items in the background
preferences.description: Even when the cache is still fresh.

preferences.name: enableWebIntegration
preferences.label: Suggest logins for the active browser tab
preferences.description: Requires the Raycast browser extension.

preferences.name: showWebsiteIcons
preferences.label: Show website icons
preferences.description: Needs a Favicon Provider in Raycast's settings. It sees the domains.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
